name: BackToTheFuture
summary: This EA scrapes real-time stock quotes from Google Finance via WebRequest and compares them against historical prices from a configurable time offset. It opens buy/sell positions when the current price deviation from the historical reference exceeds a defined bar size threshold, aiming to exploit temporary mispricings between the external feed and the broker's price.
summary_zh: 该EA通过WebRequest从Google Finance抓取实时股票报价，并与可配置时间偏移的历史价格进行比较。当当前价格与历史参考价的偏差超过设定的阈值时，开立买入或卖出仓位，旨在利用外部数据源与经纪商价格之间的临时定价偏差。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA属于统计套利类型，通过从Google Finance获取外部股票报价，与自身记录的历史价格进行对比，寻找价格偏离机会。入场条件：当当前报价与历史参考价格（可配置回溯分钟数前的价格）的差值超过BarSize阈值时入场——差值大于HistoryPrice+BarSize时做多，差值小于HistoryPrice-BarSize时做空。出场条件：采用固定的止盈和止损（TpPips/SlPips），同时还有一个基于延迟时间（DeelayPosition）的超时平仓机制，当持仓时间超过从历史数据推算的延迟时间后强制平仓。仓位管理：使用固定手数（Lots参数），并通过Count参数限制最大开仓次数，每天重置计数器。资金管理：无明显资金管理策略，固定手数交易，止损设置极大（SlPips=5000），而止盈极小（TpPips=10），风险收益比极不对称。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is statistical arbitrage, scraping external stock quotes from Google Finance and comparing them against internally recorded historical prices to detect pricing deviations. Entry conditions: A buy is triggered when the current quote deviation exceeds HistoryPrice + BarSize, and a sell when it falls below HistoryPrice - BarSize, where HistoryPrice is the price from a configurable number of minutes ago. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit (TpPips) and stop-loss (SlPips), plus a time-based exit mechanism where positions are closed after a delay period derived from historical price timestamps. Position sizing uses fixed lots with no dynamic adjustment, and the Count parameter caps the maximum number of trades per session, resetting daily. Money management is essentially absent — the default SL is 5000 ticks while TP is only 10 ticks, creating an extremely asymmetric and dangerous risk-reward ratio.

parameters.name: BarSize
parameters.description: 触发交易的价格偏差阈值
parameters.description_en: Price deviation threshold to trigger trade

parameters.name: GoogleFinanceHistoryMins
parameters.description: 历史价格回溯时间（分钟）
parameters.description_en: Historical price lookback time in minutes

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: 最大开仓次数（-1为无限制）

pros: 创新性地利用外部数据源（Google Finance）作为交易信号，思路独特
具有基于时间的自动平仓机制，避免持仓过久
支持按星期控制交易开关，灵活管理交易时段
cons: 风险收益比极差：止盈10点 vs 止损5000点，一笔亏损可抵消500次盈利
依赖Google Finance网页抓取，该接口已过时且随时可能失效，无错误重试机制
FIFO函数使用全局变量j和动态数组，缺乏边界检查，存在内存管理隐患
sessionOpened赋值为自身（line 121），逻辑错误，永远无法正确判断会话状态
无持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
pros_en: Innovative use of an external data source (Google Finance) for trade signals, offering a unique arbitrage concept
Includes a time-based automatic position closing mechanism to avoid excessive holding periods
Supports per-day-of-week trading control for flexible session management
cons_en: Extremely poor risk-reward ratio: 10 tick TP vs 5000 tick SL — one loss wipes out 500 wins
Depends on web scraping Google Finance which is outdated and unreliable, with no retry or fallback mechanism
FIFO function uses global variable j and dynamic arrays without bounds checking, posing memory management risks
Bug on line 121: sessionOpened is assigned to itself, so session state can never be correctly determined
No existing position check before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 修复sessionOpened自赋值bug，正确解析Google Finance会话状态；将止盈止损比例调整至合理范围（至少1:2以上）
替换网页抓取方式为可靠的API接口，增加错误重试和超时处理机制；添加持仓检查和同方向仓位合并逻辑
improvements_en: Fix the sessionOpened self-assignment bug and adjust the TP/SL ratio to a reasonable level (at least 1:2 or better)
Replace web scraping with a reliable API, add error retry and timeout handling, and implement position checks to prevent duplicate directional trades

risk_points: 止盈止损比例严重失衡（1:500），单次亏损可造成巨大资金损失
依赖已过时的Google Finance网页抓取，数据可能不准确或完全无法获取
无持仓检查和同方向重复开仓防护
全局变量状态管理混乱，数组越界风险
sessionOpened逻辑bug可能导致在非交易时段错误开仓
risk_points_en: Severely imbalanced TP/SL ratio (1:500), a single loss can cause catastrophic account damage
Relies on deprecated Google Finance web scraping — data may be inaccurate or completely unavailable
No existing position check or protection against duplicate directional entries
Global variable state management is chaotic with array bounds overflow risk
sessionOpened logic bug may cause trades to open outside valid session hours
